messages:
elaine: Quick proposal — try a 2-week remediation sprint cadence for postmortem actions. Owners get one sprint to triage and another to close for medium/low items; high-sev P0s stay on an accelerated path. Weekly 30m sync + async tracker updates.
matt: +1. Want a mechanism for recurring incidents: a 'pattern backlog' and monthly heatmap review so we don't re-fix the same failure modes.
sasha: Cadence idea: Day 0 incident -> owner assigned within 24h -> create initial triage card with ETA -> weekly check-ins (Tue 10:00) -> either close or move to next sprint. Simple SLA.
jamal: Can we automate reminders? @ops-bot can you schedule owner reminders 3 days before action ETAs and ping the oncall if overdue?
ops-bot: Scheduled: owner-reminder job created. Will post to #eng-oncall 3 days prior to any action ETA and escalate to oncall if overdue >48h. Use `/remind owners` to adjust.
elaine: Minimal timeline template to stick in the postmortem doc (feel free to copy):
```
- Detection: 2026-03-12 14:03 UTC
- Mitigation: rollback service-x v2.3 -> v2.2 (14:07)
- Root cause hypothesis: queue overflow on encoded-batch path
- Verification: load test + canary (owner: sasha, ETA: 2026-03-19)
- Actions:
  - patch backpressure (owner: jamal, ETA: 2026-03-26, status: in-progress)
  - add metric alert (owner: matt, ETA: 2026-03-15, status: done)
```
matt: Make every action include a fallback owner and a closure reviewer (someone who signs off on verification). Avoid single-person blackholes.
sasha: Rotation suggestion: 6-week incident commander rotation with a 1-week overlap handoff so ICs can shadow incoming ICs and transfer context.
jamal: Add a 'closure window' policy: actions older than 60 days must be escalated to Eng Manager + PM with a written rationale or be re-triaged into the pattern backlog.
elaine: Ops play: we'll create a remediation sprintboard at `boards.redwood/team-remediations`. Labels: P0/P1/P2, pattern, verification-needed. Pilot for 6 weeks.
matt: Define measurements: median time-to-close, percent actions overdue, number of recurring-mode incidents (pattern count). Monthly report to reliability council.
sasha: I'll spin up the first sprintboard and post the link here by EOD. I'll also run a 15m retro after pilot week 2 to adjust cadence.
elaine: Nice. Owners for the pilot: jamal -> backpressure patch, matt -> metric-alert followups, sasha -> verification + canary. Tagging PMs for pattern review after sprint 2. :thumbsup:
